title: S3.7c ACIS plane-surface point tolerance predicate

scope.profile: Decoded plane surface fields; parser-fed SAB 21800 rooted projection also exercised
scope.public_api: drw_pointWithinToleranceOfAcisPlaneSurface measures signed perpendicular distance to the infinite plane and accepts only within a caller-supplied tolerance.
scope.normal_policy: The stored normal is unchanged; its direction is normalized only for distance calculation.
scope.tolerance_policy: Tolerance must be finite and nonnegative; no ACIS/modeler default is inferred.
scope.refusal_policy: Absent/wrong surface, zero or non-finite normal, non-finite point/tolerance, unrepresentable distance, or out-of-tolerance point returns false without changing the output distance.
non_claims: face UV domain or trim-bound evaluation
general analytic or NURBS surface evaluation
B-rep validity or native consumer qualification
